brain._why: infer model run: ONE model turn, no agent, no tools — the safe shape for attacker-written evidence (incident reports). Goes through the running Gateway when there is one (it owns the credentials and shared state), else runs locally. --json: the answer is outputs[].text.

launch._why: chat = the terminal UI, local (no Gateway needed)

sandbox._why: OpenClaw refuses to touch its shared state unless it can see the Gateway that owns it (same PID namespace). The brain call is tool-free (infer model run), so seeing the process list is all this shares.
